tests.title: Full function over 9.0-16.0 V supply
procedure: 1. Connect controller to HIL bench with programmable supply, motor/window model and switch simulation; 23 °C; controller normalized.
2. Set supply to 9.0 V. Perform manual open/close, express open/close, anti-pinch event, and a WLC_Status read-out.
3. Repeat at 13.5 V.
4. Repeat at 16.0 V.
5. Also repeat at 9.1 V and 15.9 V (just inside the limits).
6. Log any function failure, reset or fault.
tests.pass_criteria: All functions (manual, express, anti-pinch, CAN status) work at 9.0 V, 9.1 V, 13.5 V, 15.9 V and 16.0 V with no reset or fault.

tests.title: Reduced-voltage range 6.0-9.0 V: manual only
procedure: 1. 23 °C, controller normalized, window mid-travel.
2. Set supply to 8.9 V (just below 9.0 V). Hold switch: observe manual movement. Release; apply a short press (<300 ms): observe whether express starts.
3. Repeat at 7.5 V and at 6.1 V (just above 6.0 V).
4. Set 9.0 V and apply a short press as a reference point where full function applies (see WLC-001).
tests.pass_criteria: At 8.9 V, 7.5 V and 6.1 V the window moves in manual mode while the switch is held and express mode is not started by a short press (window does not continue after release). At 9.0 V full function including express is available.

tests.title: Motor stop below 6.0 V within 50 ms
procedure: 1. 23 °C, window moving in manual mode at 7 V, motor current and motor voltage logged with a scope.
2. Step supply from 7.0 V to 5.9 V (just below limit); measure time from the supply crossing 6.0 V to motor drive off.
3. Repeat with a ramp down through 6.0 V and with a step to 5.0 V.
4. Control: hold supply at 6.1 V and verify motor continues in manual mode.
tests.pass_criteria: Motor stopped within 50 ms of supply falling below 6.0 V in all cases; motor keeps running at 6.1 V.

tests.title: Sleep mode current
procedure: 1. Connect controller to a 12 V supply (12.0 V) via a calibrated current meter, 23 °C.
2. Put controller in sleep mode (ignition off, no switch activity, CAN quiet) and wait until sleep is entered.
3. Measure supply current over at least 60 s and record the maximum.
tests.pass_criteria: Sleep current is less than 100 µA. (Temperature and voltage conditions beyond 12 V/23 °C are not specified: [TBD: limit needed] for other conditions.)

tests.title: Reverse battery withstand
procedure: 1. Record a baseline functional check (position, manual/express movement, CAN, DTC read).
2. Apply -14 V reverse polarity to the supply input for 60 s, with the motor connected; log current.
3. Restore correct polarity at 13.5 V.
4. Repeat the functional check and inspect for damage.
tests.pass_criteria: After 60 s at -14 V the controller shows no damage and the full functional check matches the baseline.

tests.title: Manual mode movement and stop on release
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, 23 °C, window mid-travel.
2. Hold switch in the close direction; verify window moves for the whole hold time (e.g. 1 s).
3. Release the switch; measure time from release to motor stop.
4. Repeat in the open direction, and 10 times each direction.
tests.pass_criteria: Window moves only while the switch is held and the motor stops within 100 ms of release in every repetition.

tests.title: Window movement after ignition off
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, ignition off, doors closed. Operate switch at 59 s after ignition off: window must move.
2. Operate switch at 61 s: window must not move.
3. Repeat ignition off; open a front door at 20 s, then operate the switch at 21 s.
4. Repeat with a rear door opened at 20 s and operate the switch at 21 s.
5. Repeat ignition off; keep doors closed and check movement at 1 s.
tests.pass_criteria: Movement allowed at 1 s and 59 s with doors closed; not allowed at 61 s; not allowed after a front door opens; rear door opening does not end the permission (window moves at 21 s).

tests.title: Express start threshold 300 ms
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, window mid-travel.
2. Press switch in close direction for 100 ms and release; observe.
3. Repeat with 299 ms press (just inside) in both close and open directions.
4. Repeat with 301 ms press (just outside); observe behavior after release.
tests.pass_criteria: Presses of 100 ms and 299 ms start express mode in the pressed direction (window continues after release). At 301 ms express does not start (manual behavior per WLC-006). Behavior at exactly 300 ms is not specified: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Second press stops express movement
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized, start express open from fully closed.
2. At mid-travel press the switch in the same direction (open); measure time to motor stop.
3. Repeat pressing the opposite direction (close).
4. Repeat for express close started from fully open, with same-direction and opposite-direction second presses.
tests.pass_criteria: In all four cases the window stops within 100 ms of the second press.

tests.title: Full travel time
procedure: 1. Set supply 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized, nominal window load.
2. Move window to fully open (480 mm).
3. Start express close and measure time from start to fully closed (0 mm).
4. Repeat 5 times.
tests.pass_criteria: Every measured open-to-closed time is within 3.0 s to 4.5 s.

tests.title: Motor stops at end position
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized.
2. Express close to 0 mm; record motor drive and position.
3. Express open to 480 mm; record motor drive and position.
4. Repeat in manual mode with switch held beyond the end position.
tests.pass_criteria: Motor drive switches off when the window reaches the end position in each case. Time/position tolerance for the stop: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: CAN WLC_CloseAll express close with anti-pinch
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized, window fully open.
2. Send WLC_CloseAll from the simulated body controller; observe window close without switch input.
3. Repeat and insert a simulated obstacle >80 N in the pinch zone during closing.
tests.pass_criteria: Window closes in express mode on WLC_CloseAll, and on an obstacle the pinch reaction of WLC-015 occurs (stop and reversal).

tests.title: Express close only when normalized
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, window mid-travel, controller normalized: short press close; observe express.
2. Cause not-normalized state (supply interruption 600 ms).
3. Short press close; observe.
4. Send WLC_CloseAll while not normalized and observe (spec does not define it).
tests.pass_criteria: Express close works when normalized and is not available when not normalized (only manual movement). Response to WLC_CloseAll when not normalized: observe and record [TBD: limit needed] (potential conflict with WLC-012).

tests.title: Pinch detection threshold and zone
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, 23 °C, normalized. Use force-simulating obstacle on HIL.
2. Close window and apply 79 N at 100 mm: no detection expected. Repeat at 4 mm and 200 mm.
3. Apply 81 N at 100 mm, at 5 mm and at 199 mm: detection expected.
4. Apply 81 N at 201 mm and 3 mm (just outside zone); observe and record.
tests.pass_criteria: No pinch detected at 79 N inside the zone (4 mm to 200 mm); pinch detected at 81 N inside the zone. Behavior outside the zone is not specified: observe [TBD: limit needed]. Exact threshold 80 N is not required to be a trigger (exceeds 80 N).

tests.title: Pinch reaction: stop time and reversal distance
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized, closing at 100 mm with 100 N obstacle; log motor drive and position.
2. Measure time from detection to motor stop and the reversal distance travelled.
3. Repeat at 5 mm and 200 mm start positions, and with the window starting near fully open so reversal could reach 480 mm (if feasible in the model).
tests.pass_criteria: Motor stopped within 10 ms of detection; window reverses by at least 150 mm or to fully open (480 mm), whichever is less.

tests.title: Anti-pinch active in manual and express
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized.
2. Close in manual mode (switch held) and apply 100 N obstacle at 100 mm.
3. Close in express mode and apply 100 N obstacle at 100 mm.
tests.pass_criteria: A pinch is detected and reaction occurs in both modes.

tests.title: Anti-pinch disabled when not normalized
procedure: 1. 13.5 V; make controller not normalized (supply interruption 600 ms).
2. Close in manual mode and apply 100 N obstacle at 100 mm in the HIL model (no real person/obstacle).
3. Check WLC_Status normalization state.
4. Normalize the controller, repeat and confirm anti-pinch active.
tests.pass_criteria: When not normalized no pinch reaction (no stop/reversal) occurs at the obstacle; when normalized the pinch reaction occurs.

tests.title: Express close inhibit after pinch reversal
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized; trigger a pinch reversal once.
2. After reversal completes, attempt express close at 1.9 s after the pinch (just inside the inhibit).
3. Repeat the pinch and attempt express close at 2.1 s (just outside).
4. During the inhibit, try manual close.
tests.pass_criteria: Express close is inhibited for 2 s after the pinch reversal and available at 2.1 s. Manual close during inhibit: observe [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Three pinches within 30 s: manual-only closing for 60 s
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, normalized. Trigger three pinch detections within 30 s (e.g. at 0, 10, 25 s).
2. Immediately attempt express close and manual close.
3. Attempt express close at 59 s and 61 s after the third pinch.
4. Separate run: three pinches spaced over 31 s (e.g. 0, 15, 31 s) and attempt express close.
tests.pass_criteria: After three pinches within 30 s, closing is allowed only in manual mode for 60 s; express close is available after 60 s. With pinches spread over more than 30 s the restriction is not applied.

tests.title: Position resolution
procedure: 1. Normalized; drive Hall pulse simulation with known pulse spacing.
2. Move window in steps of 0.5 mm and read position via WLC_Status.
3. Compare reported position to reference over several points across the 0-480 mm travel.
tests.pass_criteria: Reported position resolves steps of 0.5 mm or better.

tests.title: Not normalized after supply interruption >500 ms
procedure: 1. Normalized controller, 13.5 V.
2. Interrupt supply for 400 ms; check normalization state in WLC_Status.
3. Interrupt for 499 ms and 501 ms; check state each time (re-normalize between runs).
4. Interrupt for 2 s.
tests.pass_criteria: After interruptions longer than 500 ms (501 ms, 2 s) the controller is not normalized; at 400 ms and 499 ms it remains normalized. Behavior at exactly 500 ms is not specified.

tests.title: Normalization at closed position
procedure: 1. Start not normalized, 13.5 V.
2. In manual mode drive the window fully closed against the seal and keep holding the switch for 0.9 s; check state.
3. Repeat holding for 1.0 s and 1.1 s.
4. Attempt in express mode.
tests.pass_criteria: Controller becomes normalized when the window is held closed against the seal for 1 s in manual mode; not normalized at 0.9 s hold.

tests.title: Thermal model review
procedure: 1. Review software design documents and thermal model implementation.
2. Verify motor temperature is estimated from model inputs (e.g. current, time, ambient).
tests.pass_criteria: A thermal model exists and estimates motor temperature. Accuracy of the estimate: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Thermal current limit and block thresholds with hysteresis
procedure: 1. Use HIL to inject/override the estimated motor temperature (or load profile).
2. Raise estimate to 129 °C: measure motor current in a load case; then 131 °C.
3. Raise to 139 °C: attempt open and close; then 141 °C.
4. Lower from 141 °C: attempt opening at 125 °C, 121 °C, 119 °C.
5. Record current limit behavior as temperature falls.
tests.pass_criteria: Above 130 °C motor current is limited to 15 A (not limited at 129 °C). Above 140 °C opening is blocked and closing is allowed; at 139 °C opening allowed. Blocking ends when temperature falls below 120 °C (still blocked at 121 °C). When the current limit ends: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: WLC_Status cycle time
procedure: 1. 13.5 V; log CAN with timestamps for 10 min while idle and during window movement.
2. Calculate the interval between consecutive WLC_Status frames.
3. Verify signals: position, movement state, normalization state, fault state.
tests.pass_criteria: All intervals are 45 ms to 55 ms (50 ms ± 5 ms); message contains all four signals with correct values.

tests.title: Hall sensor loss DTC B1A01
procedure: 1. Motor driven, normalized, 13.5 V.
2. Remove Hall pulses for 150 ms and restore: check no DTC.
3. Remove Hall pulses for 250 ms: observe DTC and motor.
4. Read DTCs. Also remove pulses while motor not driven for 300 ms.
tests.pass_criteria: With signal missing for more than 200 ms (250 ms) while driven, B1A01 is stored and the motor stops. No DTC at 150 ms or when the motor is not driven. Stop time: [TBD: limit needed].

tests.title: Overcurrent DTC B1A02, motor stop and fault state
procedure: 1. Drive motor at 13.5 V; inject motor current of 24 A for 100 ms: check no B1A02.
2. Inject 26 A for 40 ms: check no DTC.
3. Inject 26 A for 60 ms: read DTCs, observe motor and WLC_Status fault state.
4. Repeat with 25.5 A for 55 ms.
tests.pass_criteria: B1A02 stored only when current exceeds 25 A for more than 50 ms. When stored, the motor is stopped and the fault state in WLC_Status is set. No DTC, stop or fault at 24 A or 26 A/40 ms.

tests.title: Diagnostic response time
procedure: 1. 13.5 V, awake. Send diagnostic requests (e.g. DTC read, identification) from tester 100 times.
2. Measure time from request end to response start.
3. Repeat while the window is moving.
tests.pass_criteria: Every response arrives within 50 ms.

tests.title: Operation across ambient temperature
procedure: 1. Place controller with motor/window load in chamber, 13.5 V.
2. Soak at -40 °C for sufficient time, then run manual, express, anti-pinch and CAN checks.
3. Repeat at 85 °C.
4. Repeat at 23 °C as reference.
tests.pass_criteria: Controller operates and passes functional checks at -40 °C, 85 °C and 23 °C. Performance limits of other requirements apply where specified.

tests.title: Wake from sleep on switch press
procedure: 1. Put controller in sleep mode at 13.5 V, 23 °C.
2. Press the switch; measure time from press to wake (supply current rise / CAN WLC_Status / motor command).
3. Repeat 10 times for both directions.
tests.pass_criteria: Controller wakes within 100 ms of the switch press in every repetition.
